correctness.rationale: The exact compatible DDE linearization has one simple center eigenvalue and remaining characteristic roots -mu,-m_i. On the K=0 center manifold the delayed shift contributes only at third order, the infected-population convolution has no quadratic term, and the phage equations yield Q_i=r_i[1-(A_i/m_i)u+(A_i/m_i)^2 u^2]+O(u^3). Hence u'=-Cu^3+O(u^4), with C a strictly positive weighted sum of squares when some Ai is nonzero. Stable-foliation shadowing plus the exact positive S logarithmic identity proves the rate for all sufficiently nearby compatible positive initial data. When all Ai=0, direct substitution verifies a line of equilibria. Symbolic rational tests and finite DDE integration corroborate, but do not prove infinite-time behavior.
